data.credibility: Dixon shows mixed delivery. They successfully met capex targets and keep long-term volume goals on track, but frequently let short-term execution slip or quietly drop specific revenue guidance topics across quarters.

lines.line: Camera modules volume targeted at 190 to 200 million units.
Camera revenue target of INR 6,000 to 7,000 crores dropped.
INR 3,000 crore component investment commitment dropped.
IT business revenue target raised to Rs. 15,000 to 20,000 crores.
$1.5 to $2 billion domestic market target dropped.
Display facility trial repeatedly delayed and slipping.
Washing machine mass production delayed and slipping.
FY26 capex delivered between INR 1,100 and 1,200 crores.
Telecom target of INR 7,500 to 8,000 crores lowered then dropped.
Lighting segment target of INR 1,700 crores dropped.
Camera module revenue target of INR 2,500 crores dropped.
Target revenue of INR 56,000 crores in FY27 on track.
Smartphone volume growth target of 20% to 25% missed.
Refrigerator capacity expansion to 3.2 million units pending.
IT hardware revenue targeted at INR 6,000 crores.
Display business revenue targeted at INR 6,000 to 7,000 crores.
Q Tech revenue targeted between INR 2,500 and 3,000 crores.

overrides.reason: History shows it was lowered in Q1 FY27 and not mentioned in Q2 FY27, indicating it was dropped.
